description: This Java source file defines a Spring service implementation class for reading external asset owner loan product attributes in the Fineract system. It provides methods to retrieve data with caching and validation logic, and interacts with repositories and mappers.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for reading external asset owner loan product attributes, implements methods with caching, validation, and database querying logic.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductAttributesByLoanProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of external transfer loan product attributes filtered by loanProductId and optional attributeKey, with caching enabled.

methods.name: validateLoanProduct
methods.description: Validates the existence of a loan product by its ID, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductAttributesByLoanProductIdAndAttributeKeySpecification
methods.description: Creates a JPA Specification to filter ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributes by loanProductId and optionally attributeKey.
